planner.note: Same settings as batch_evaluate.js quality mode, so cached planner ratings are reused (via migration).

SCREEN.use: early stop (synthesis section 6 step 4); discarded after use
SCREEN.equivalence: Campaign r of a meter call uses seed (seed + imul(r+1, 0x9e3779b9))|0, so {runs:20,seeds:1,seed:4711} is exactly the first (visible) sub-block of the CURVE 4711 call. screen.js reads it from a cached CURVE 4711 rating when one exists.

sequential.rule: After 5, 10 and 15 campaigns, stop when the running mean m_n is beyond threshold t by more than z * sd(t) / sqrt(n), where sd(t) is the per-campaign SD of a geometric number of tries with mean t, capped at 20. Chunk j is the meter call {runs:5, seeds:1, seed:(4711 + imul(5j, 0x9e3779b9))|0}: the same campaigns as SCREEN, so a board that is not stopped gets exactly the SCREEN value.

calibration.command: node source/tools/builder/loop/screen.js --calibrate --out source/build/screen-cal.json (2026-11-07, 1.5 min, no bot runs)
calibration.criterion: smallest z with a false-stop rate <= 2% for a board exactly at the threshold, every threshold 2-18.5, both sides (task10_speed.js used the same 2% criterion)
calibration.model: min(Geometric, 20) with mean t; its SD matches the real per-campaign spread of 634 cached key-memory ratings (observed/model 0.97, 0.87, 0.94, 0.96, 1.00 in D bands 1-3, 3-6, 6-10, 10-14, 14-20)
calibration.power: z 3: a board at D 2 against lo-1 = 9 stops in 100% after 10.2 campaigns on average; D 3 vs 9: 93%, 13.0 campaigns; D 15 vs hi+1 = 7: 98%, 7.6 campaigns; a board 2 SCREEN-SEs beyond the threshold stops in only 0-25%. The censoring condition (D(1) >= 18.5) can never stop early at z 3 (its bound passes 20); it is checked at 20 campaigns.

CURVE.use: every spare of a puzzle, paired (same seeds at every spare)
CURVE.pooling: Production pooling (batch_evaluate.js rate mode, empirical_confirm.js, task11_rerate.js): two meter calls {setting:'family', runs:20, seeds:2} at seed 4711 and seed 18427, 40 campaigns each, pooled = (exp4711 + exp18427) / 2. Production rated the reference bot's 4711 call with capture:'tail' (part of the cache key, not of the rating); Codex rated key memory without capture. The yardstick looks up both cache variants before measuring.
CURVE.visibleCampaigns: The meter returns per-campaign results only for the first sub-block of each call (the first 20 of 40). SEs are estimated from those 40 of 80 campaigns (sample SD / sqrt(80)); D itself uses all 80 (mean of the two calls' expectedTries).

ACCEPT.use: the value of record; never reused, never used for choosing
ACCEPT.note: Block j is meter call {runs:20, seeds:2, seed: 29717 + 15838*j}. Its two sub-blocks are 29717 + 7919*(2j) and 29717 + 7919*(2j+1), so blocks never overlap each other or 4711/12630/18427/26346. Block 0 equals production's reserved final seed (final_seed.js SEED = 29717).

steps: If |D - T| > 2.5 x tolerance: refuse the pair for that slot (the puzzle goes back to the library).
Otherwise measure up to 320 campaigns (8 blocks) and accept only if |D - T| <= tolerance.
acceptance.ledgerRule: ACCEPT blocks are counted per puzzle (the design with clock.n removed), across all spares and fingerprints. accept() reserves blocks [start, start + maxCampaigns/40) in the ledger before measuring and never measures a reserved block again.

tolerance.note: Dennis's fixed tolerances, reaffirmed 2026-11-08. No relative widening.

curveRules.note: canShip follows synthesis section 3. openingClock (k at move 0 <= 6 means spare >= 2) is a flag; shippableOpeningRule lists the spares that also pass it. No peak exception. releaseTestSpare is the spare t_clocks.js checks: clock.n - (index of the clock in the stored solution) - 1 must be 1-3.

note: Fixed geometry/roles, no face-down tiles; module count and clock thaw varied before rating. CURVE only. No ACCEPT, production changes or accepted levels.
